Stipends for MSU Students

From the ORA eTraining module "Supporting Participants: Payments, Benefits, and Indirect Costs" (lesson 3 of 9).
Things to Know: Prior to Stipend Request Submission
https://cdn.articulate.com/assets/rise/assets/block-defaults/mountains_thumb.jpg
On the Stipend Memo you are required to enter a 'check issue date' referring to when the State of Maryland will cut the check. This date MUST be 45 days or more from the DocuSign submission date.
Check Issue Date (Lead Time)
Please review the project's budget in Banner prior to DocuSign submission to ensure appropriate funds are available in pool level 12 (Participant Support Costs). Insufficient funds will result in DocuSign decline.
Review Project Budget
It is good practice to have each stipend recipient complete a W-9 (attached in this lesson). It may be requested by Accounts Payable for payment processing.
Completed W-9
Stipend requests can't be submitted for more than one month of support at a time. Additionally, stipend requests should not be submitted more than 60 days in advance.
Month-by-Month Submission
State of Maryland and MSU end-of-year closures can result in delayed stipend payments. For example, Accounts Payable may state any December check issue dates beyond December 10th will not be processed by the State until January.
Year-End Processing: December Stipends
Setting up direct deposit for stipend payments can get payments to your participants faster! For up to date information on registering for direct deposit please visit Morgan's Accounts Payable site here .
Direct Deposit
Stipend payment requests are processed by Morgan State University’s Accounts Payable team. For detailed guidance on submitting stipend requests, please visit the Accounts Payable Stipend Submission page here . For status updates on submitted payment requests, please contact the Accounts Payable office directly only if more than 45 days have passed since submission through DocuSign.
Stipends are distinct from participant incentives (e.g., payments for questionnaires or focus groups), which are administered through the MSU Working Fund process as outlined in ORA's Navigating Banner: Essentials for Research Administration e-module.
Complete the content above before moving on.
DocuSign: Stipend Required Information
Stipend requests for sponsored awards should utilize the Stipend Request Memo DocuSign form found on ORA's Post Award Forms page. For non-MSU participants, please refer to the "Stipends for External Students" lesson of this module.
School and Department Info
List your School and the Department, Center, or Major Program funding this stipend request.
Contact Lead & Date
Identify the project's Principal Investigator (PI) or Program Director (PD). Also, enter today's date which will serve as the DocuSign form submission date.
Award Title & Funding Period
List the title as written on the project's Notice of Award (NOA), the sponsor's name, and the award number. Also, include the month, term, and year for which support is funded by this request.
Banner Funding Codes
When an award is established the RFA team creates a FOAPAL (fund, org code, account, program, activity, location) string is established that uniquely identifies the award in Banner. Look for an email from the Restricted Funds Accounting (RFA) team or send an email to ask.ora@morgan.edu (opens in a new tab) if you do not know this information.
Banner Account Code
Select the appropriate account code depending on the student classification (12042 for Undergraduate students and 12043 for Graduate students).
Contact for Questions
Add contact information for any questions related to this request. This may be the PI or designated program manager or admin.
School Address & Contact Number
Please include the school, mailing address, and contact number for your department.
Candidate Name
Enter the stipend/honoraria recipient's full legal name.
MSU ID and SSN
Each student should have an active MSU ID and Social Security Number (SSN) to be paid by the State of Maryland. Individuals without a SSN will need to work with the Office of International Affairs to receive one.
Mailing Address
List the address to where stipend checks should be mailed. Morgan State should not be used as a recipient's mailing address for stipend checks.
Stipend Amount
Include the amount to be paid to each individual in this column. Be sure stipend amounts listed are allocable to the project's scope and allowable under the project's Notice of Award and sponsor/program guidelines.
Check Issue Date
Check Issue Dates MUST be more than 45 days after the DocuSign submission date. This is the date by which the State of Maryland should authorize payment of the outlined requests. Physical payments can take up to 5 business days beyond the check issue date to be received by the payee. Direct deposit payments are generally faster.
